openMandatoryFindings.title: Known unsafe public-report root/ancestor is traversed by metadata-only observer before HOLD
openMandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Validate fixed report components from trusted anchor outward before is_file/rglob/target stat; reject unexpected links/non-directories and uncertain observations immediately; permit validated missing subtree as honest no-current metadata; add actual-function no-callback-on-unsafe and paired safe missing/stale/current controls.
